sections.heading: Our Story
sections.text: Our Christmas light display combines a love of Christmas with a desire to make people smile. It all began in 2020 when our son, Thomas, was just eight years old and decided to decorate our home with a handful of lights. What started as a small display quickly grew into a family tradition that grows every year.

sections.heading: Why We Do This
sections.text: In 2023, we invited visitors to make charity donations and raised £251.44 for Mountbatten Isle of Wight, a charity that has supported our family and many others in times of need. In 2024, we raised £200.31 for RSPCA Isle of Wight, to thank them for caring for our kittens that were rescued from Lynbottom Household Waste Recycling Centre in 2022. In 2025 we raised £450.23 for Vectis Corps of Drums Marching Band who keep us entertained all year round!

sections.heading: The Display
sections.text: Each year, we add to the display to make it bigger and better. This year, we have even more surprises! We look forward to welcoming visitors again this year and raising even more for charity — but above all, we just love making people smile!
